capabilities.name: RFC 8785 canonical JSON encoding
capabilities.description: A Python reference helper encodes JSON-compatible values as RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 bytes.
limitations: Only a Python reference implementation exists; cross-language conformance vectors have not been tested.
Payload size and nesting-depth limits must be enforced by callers.

capabilities.name: Strict UTF-8 JSON decoding
capabilities.description: A strict JSON decoder rejects invalid UTF-8, malformed JSON, duplicate object keys and non-standard numeric constants, with optional canonical-form enforcement.
limitations: Schema-bound AIX message validation is a separate next-stage integration.
Payload size and nesting-depth limits must be enforced by callers.

capabilities.name: Cross-language codec conformance
capabilities.description: Shared vectors and independent implementations will verify byte-identical canonicalization across languages.
limitations: No second-language implementation or cross-language conformance suite exists yet.

explicit_non_capabilities: Schema registry publication or compatibility enforcement
Private model reasoning or chain-of-thought serialization
